turns.message: Draft me a 4-bullet plan for keeping on top of all four courses this term.
turns.reply:
Here's a suggested plan for managing your four courses this term:

*▁▁▁**Review Syllabi:** [S1] First, examine the syllabi for Agentic AI, Asset Management, Data Mining, and Negotiations to note important dates, readings, and assignments.
*▁▁▁**Create a Master Calendar:** [S1] Build a single calendar with all due dates and key topics for each course. This provides a comprehensive overview.
*▁▁▁**Allocate Weekly Study Blocks:** [S1] Dedicate specific blocks of time each week to each course, prioritizing those with closer deadlines or more challenging material.
*▁▁▁**Regularly Review and Adjust:** [S1] Schedule brief weekly reviews of your calendar and study blocks to ensure you're on track and make necessary adjustments.
